explication: Tandoor Recipes is a collaborative recipe-management application. Users browse, search, import, and organize recipes, then plan meals and turn recipes or plans into shopping lists; the application persists household and recipe data and presents it through the web interface. The README also highlights cookbooks, AI assistance, recipe-manager imports, and file sync, so these appear as distinct capabilities. The tree and excerpts support the main Django/Vue structure, but do not expose every endpoint or helper call; uncertain internal wiring is therefore left out.
